criteria.reason: Playground analogy, simple vocabulary, direct address to child; language fits a 10-year-old.
100,000 signatures stated correctly, but the 18-month collection deadline is omitted entirely.
Engaging numbered steps and analogy, but repetitive closing sections make it overlong for a child.

summary: Child-friendly playground analogy with correct 100,000-signature count and final national vote, but omits the 18-month signature deadline and is somewhat long and repetitive.
